label: Night temple hero
desc: Cinematic full-bleed landing page for a lantern-lit mountain retreat: a monumental night temple scene (parallax ridges, mist, rain, a lit pagoda, a pointer-carried lantern that really lights the title), two lines of widely tracked display type, one call to action, then a scroll-linked night-to-dawn journey with a split-flap clock, rooms with a validated booking dialog, rituals and a letters form.
use: travel, hospitality or event landing page with an atmospheric night hero

label: Living green hero
desc: A botanical landing page whose first screen is one object: a glass terrarium with a miniature moss forest inside (refracting rim, condensation, running drops, chrome base) centred between a split serif headline, with hairline callouts, drifting spores, pointer parallax and a liquid-metal CTA. Below: a scroll-revealed story, a filterable and sortable bento shelf with a working basket and checkout, a self-drawing vine timeline and a newsletter form.
use: organic product, skincare, wellness or garden brand landing page whose hero is one hero object

label: Book showcase hero
desc: Editorial publisher landing page on a 12-column grid: an enormous serif headline crosses a tall CSS-3D book (cover, spine, page block, slow turn, pointer tilt) and is cut along its real silhouette, small-caps facts, a lede, one action, a marquee of review quotes, a keyboard tab list of six covers with a 3D detail panel, excerpt and reading-list dialogs, a canvas-poster player with seek, speed, captions and a clickable transcript, and a validated newsletter.
use: publisher, bookshop, magazine or editorial landing page
